name: category-review
title: Category review pack
for_each: select id,name from stores order by code

sections.title: Product range
sections.sql: select sku,product,range_status,units,sales_amount,cost_amount,gross_margin_amount,stock_days,currency from range_performance where store_id=$1 order by sku

sections.title: Missing and off-range products
sections.sql: select sku,product,issue from assortment_gaps where store_id=$1 order by sku

sections.title: Follow-up
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on,closed_on,resolution from actions where store_id=$1 order by due_on

name: range-decision
title: Range decision record
for_each: select d.id,p.name from decisions d join products p on p.id=d.product_id order by d.created_at

sections.title: Recommendation and rationale
sections.note: A recommendation does not update the store range or send instructions to a store.

sections.title: Frozen evidence
sections.sql: select snapshot from decisions where id=$1
